title: Ember Optimizations
description: Ember Optimizations boosts Minecraft FPS on low-to-high-end PCs. This particular modpack has unique configurations to improve the performance of Minecraft!
body:
### Introducing Ember Optimizations Ember Optimizations is a Forge modpack for Minecraft 1.20.1 built for one purpose — to make the game run the way it should. Whether you're on a budget laptop or a high-end rig, Ember delivers a smoother, more responsive experience without stripping away what makes Minecraft feel like Minecraft. ### From the Creators of Prism Optimized Ember Optimizations is made by me [(SodaPlays)](https://modrinth.com/user/SodaPlays). I am the person behind **Prism Optimized**. This modpack was built from the ground up for Forge. If you've used Prism before, you'll feel right at home. Same philosophy, same attention to detail, different loader.
![Ember Optimizations](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a887b45126b775f5dd5beb154e07186ceb56c80e.png) [![Discord](https://i.imgur.com/j51LDaQ.png)](https://discord.gg/DMV28j3BSK) [![Bluesky](https://i.imgur.com/8WtUbWY.png)](https://bsky.app/profile/sodaplays.bsky.social) [![YouTube](https://i.imgur.com/USGe94v.png)](https://www.youtube.com/@SodaPlays_YT/videos)
### Performance & Stability At its core, Ember is built around a carefully selected set of optimization mods, all configured to work together rather than against each other. From chunk loading to entity rendering, every system has been tuned to reduce stutters, lower memory usage, and push frame rates as high as your hardware allows. ### OptiFine Feature Support Leaving OptiFine behind doesn't mean leaving your resource packs behind. Ember includes ETF (Entity Texture Features), EMF (Entity Model Features), and Continuity, covering the vast majority of OptiFine-dependent features, including custom entity textures, model overrides, and connected textures. For most packs, you can drop them straight in, and they'll just work. ### Shader Support Ember ships with Oculus, bringing full shader support to Forge. Whether you want to play vanilla or completely transform the look of the game with shaders, both are supported out of the box. ### What's Included
General Mods - Embeddium + FerriteCore + ModernFix for core performance gains - Entity Culling + ImmediatelyFast for rendering efficiency - Concurrent Chunk Management Engine for smooth chunk loading at any render distance - ETF, EMF, Continuity, and OptiGUI for OptiFine resource pack compatibility - Oculus for shader support - And more — all pre-configured and ready to go
### People Behind EO (Ember Optimizations) I want to say a special thanks to these people for helping with the creation of **EO** and **PO**! - [Vinyard](https://modrinth.com/user/Vinyard) - [Toasty_Toaster](https://modrinth.com/user/Toasty_Toaster) - [kibble_](https://modrinth.com/user/kibble_)
